conventions.commitMessage: type(scope): summary. Human id RM-NN may appear in the body. To move the GitHub card use Closes #<issue-number> from githubIssue.number — GitHub does not auto-link #RM-NN.
conventions.afterEachCommit: Set that item status to done, append { message, sha }. Fill the previous item sha in this commit if it was self-referential (empty). Do not add a separate 'update roadmap' commit.
conventions.lookup: Item → commits[] is the forward map. byCommit[sha] → item ids is the reverse map. byIssue[issueNumber] → item id. githubIssue.number is what PRs must close.
conventions.github: Run `node backlog/sync-projects.mjs` to upsert Issues + Project V2. Re-runs are idempotent.
